newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's VAE in Russia rail JV. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Austria's VAE in Russia rail JV. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]

text.p: Austria's VAE said on Monday it would form a joint venture (JV) with Russian switch maker WW Murom to upgrade Russia's outdated rail infrastructure.
(Corrects headline and text to show VAE is an independent company, not a unit of VA Technologie group.)
The 50/50 venture would be led by VAE, the group said in a statement on Monday.

The company would supply switches for the Russian market produced at existing plants in Austria and in Russia before a joint production facility would be set up in Murom, about 300 km east of Moscow, in about two years.
